ISLAND

A small world like ours. Bands of families on an island they have not explored. Nothing is scripted; you watch.

The long view

One point a year: people alive (white), born that year (green), died that year (red), share of the island known (gold, 0-100%), generations (blue). Skipping runs the same world faster without drawing the map.

Tap a person

Tap someone on the map (or press Follow) to see their body, what they are doing and why, and their life so far.

    Key
